name: Muzzle flash (side-on)
description: A single one-frame muzzle flash seen from the side, then a faint wisp of gun smoke. Flip it to fire left.

looks.text: A close view of a muzzle flash: flame shape and colour only.

prompt.subject: a gunshot muzzle flash at {where}
prompt.timing: a single bright muzzle flash bursts from {where} at {flash}, leaving a faint wisp of smoke that is gone by {clear}
prompt.action: At {flash} the gun fires: a single brief white-yellow muzzle flash lasting one frame bursts from {where}, lighting the shooter's hands and face for an instant, followed by a faint wisp of gun smoke that quickly disappears.
